text: The only news that I have is that you're about to become fertilizer.

text: An intruder!

text: Your manner betrays you, intruder. I will end the threat here.

text: 你的表情出卖了你，入侵者。我现在就会清除你对我们的威胁。

text: You cannot be serious. In fact, you must be lying.

text: Uh, yeah, so what?

text: 啊，好，那又如何？

text: I'm not. The Lieutenant could not trust this message to the usual method. I have to see the Master right now! There is no time to waste!
source_text: I'm not. The Lieutenant could not trust this message to the usual method. I have to see the Master right now! There is no time to waste!

text: 不是。中尉无法确信常规的方法可以传送这个消息。我必须立刻见主教！不能在这里浪费时间！

text: Then use the door, and beware the Corridor. I assume that you haveyour protection in place?

text: 从那里走，走廊上要注意，我想你做好了保护措施。
